meta.description: Personality, hobbies, site philosophy, site features, nested keyboard shortcuts, blog pipeline architecture, and interests of Prasad Gade

data.who: Prasad Gade is a computer engineer and a data analyst who builds software, works with data, and creates intelligent tools to solve real problems.

site_philosophy.what: This is Prasad's digital home — an interactive, visual resume that also reflects his personality.
site_philosophy.who_is_it_for: Everyone. Recruiters, friends, colleagues, tech and non-tech people, or anyone curious about who Prasad is.
site_philosophy.why: Not created just to tick a box. Built because Prasad wanted to and enjoys it. The site gives a platform to demonstrate skills and interests.
site_philosophy.approach: Values simplicity, user empathy, and creativity. Includes a Start Here modal for non-tech visitors, resume opens in-app to retain people, and every UI detail is intentional.

site_features: 4 visual themes: dark, light, arcade dark, arcade light
No-scroll desktop layout (everything fits one screen)
3D Minecraft skin viewer using skinview3d and Three.js
Paper playground: screen turns into a crumpled paper with real cloth physics simulation
Hidden easter eggs: Konami code and hesoyam trigger animations
Nested keyboard navigation across cards, filters, and links; press ? to open the in-app guide
Theme cycling remains available even while the help, movies, resume, or Minecraft modal is open
The Minecraft skin viewer supports a space-to-jump shortcut when focused
Start Here modal for non-tech visitors explaining all sections
Resume opens in an in-app modal (no redirect)
Responsive for mobile, tablet, and desktop-site-on-mobile
Every modal closes on ESC key

jump_within_active_tab.home: Focus the first interactive item in the active tab
jump_within_active_tab.end: Focus the last interactive item in the active tab

keyboard_shortcuts.note: Shortcuts are ignored while typing inside inputs, textareas, selects, and contenteditable fields.
keyboard_shortcuts.focus_order_note: Inside interactive tabs, focus moves through cards first and then their nested links or actions. About and Skills do not have in-tab interactive targets.
keyboard_shortcuts.modal_note: Theme cycling stays available while the Start Here, movies, resume, or Minecraft modal is open. The Minecraft viewer responds to Space when it is focused.

site_architecture.hosting: Static React portfolio hosted on GitHub Pages at prasadgade.dev
site_architecture.agent_surface: Read-only machine-readable files live under public/, including llms.txt, llms-full.txt, OpenAPI, A2A, WebMCP, MCP discovery, API catalog, and static JSON endpoints.

shortcuts_system.target_marker: Interactive in-pane targets opt into keyboard navigation with data-shortcut-target="true".
shortcuts_system.navigation_model: Global shortcuts switch tabs and open overlays; active-tab navigation moves through visible shortcut targets, including nested card links/actions, blog filters, sort controls, blog cards, and share buttons.
shortcuts_system.input_safety: Shortcuts are ignored while typing inside inputs, textareas, selects, and contenteditable fields.

blog_pipeline.source: Each post lives in a numbered subfolder inside blog-posts/.
blog_pipeline.required_files: Every post folder must contain exactly one Markdown file and one PNG thumbnail; extra non-ignorable files fail the sync.
blog_pipeline.caching: Generated pages, thumbnails, and shared files are written only when their content changes; unchanged outputs are skipped on repeat runs.
blog_pipeline.stale_cleanup: Generated blog folders and copied assets are pruned when the source post is deleted or renamed.
blog_pipeline.build_integration: npm run build runs blogs:sync through the prebuild hook, and npm run deploy runs build before publishing.
